status: Qualified independent solo witnesses; not Phone helper-route activation or universal replay acceptance
fixture_scope: Startup local room/position is relocated to native316 at80,128; the other three start in801 at232,232. A blank native file and synthetic ROM identity are used.
Experimental Phone is enabled before boot but remains unowned. No R input, client receipt, guarded write, memory injection or mid-run state load is used.
The player remains Normal. Off-room CPU abilities can differ; they are not asserted to remain Normal.
Retail static source assignments and room geometry are unchanged. Area Keys are ON. Health6 means production minimum6/maximum10; health1 means minimum1/maximum1.
The only allowed preboot differences from the shipping patched ROM are startup rooms/positions, synthetic identity, Phone enable word, health word, ability-gating mask and finalized GBA header.
Per-frame audits begin at settled gameplay frame2248, not during title/startup menus.
findings: Two separate solo target witnesses use the actual316-to322 doorway: the small chest and the ordinary322-to315 exit. They are not one continuous chest-then-exit run.

The chest route uses Normal slide to open the floor Bomb Block, then the lower passage and flight to the chest. Native flag42 and event0x088C4F24 establish collection; settled idle and subsequent movement establish control.
Chest-high succeeds atHP6 twice andHP1 once with ability gating OFF. Chest-low succeeds atHP6 once andHP1 twice with gating ON. All accepted audits preserve initial HP.
The ordinary exit succeeds with the same controller schedule atHP6/gatingOFF, HP1/gatingOFF andHP1/gatingON, ending in315 with subsequent movement.
These counterexamples prevent inferring that Phone is mandatory for the chest or whole ordinary exit merely because a large block exists elsewhere in322. No graph binding is changed.
